verdict.rationale: Kommo's homepage markets itself as an 'AI CRM' that automates conversations, appointments and workflows, with an 'AI-powered inbox' and 'AI scheduling'. That suggests built-in AI that handles some work for the user, but there is no documentation of an assistant you can actually hand tasks to. SalesBot is a scripted scenario editor, not an AI assistant, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of a built-in AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks, details of what it can do, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: All-in-one AI CRM to automate WhatsApp, TikTok, and Instagram conversations, appointments, and workflows.
